headline: Colombia Asks Energy Savings as Hydroelectric Reservoirs Drop to 77.1%
summary: Colombia's government urged energy conservation to prevent potential power outages after water reservoir levels fell to 77.14 percent, with rainfall deficits projected to linger into 2027.
why: Colombia relies heavily on hydroelectric power generation. Depleted water reservoirs threaten electricity supply stability and can force increased reliance on thermal power generation.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Reduced hydroelectric generation risks elevated power costs and regional energy rationing.
